title: Fire Emitter
body:
"It emits a nice and colorful fire depending on material"


Description

Fire Emitter is a one-time use schematic purchasable at Illumine Designs for $900.

When placed on the property, it takes appearance of a cube schematic engulfed in default fire particle effect, also emmiting light.

It can be filled with any material, which will affect the color of flames and light.
